Contraindicated [erythromycin:contraindications:0].

Erythromycin is contraindicated in patients taking simvastatin because erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 [erythromycin:drug_interactions:3], the enzyme responsible for metabolizing simvastatin [simvastatin:drug_interactions:2]. This inhibition can lead to increased plasma levels of simvastatin [erythromycin:drug_interactions:3], significantly raising the risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis [erythromycin:contraindications:0].
